caption:
Play-Doh started as a putty for cleaning wallpaper. When that market died, it became a toy. 🎨 Sometimes your product is right, just sold to the wrong people. Agree? 👇

Source: Wikipedia

#DidYouKnow #PlayDoh #Pivot #ProductStory #Marketing

post.news: Did you know? Play-Doh was first sold as a wallpaper cleaner.
post.take: Best pivot ever: from cleaning walls to kids trying to eat it.
